content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Selling Notion templates for crypto means leveraging decentralized payment systems that allow creators to bypass traditional financial platforms. This approach empowers you to maintain full control over your products while minimizing transaction costs. Without the burdensome fees imposed by platforms like Gumroad, which can charge up to 10% on every sale, you can retain more of your earnings. With NOWPayments, you only pay a mere 0.5%, preserving your profits and allowing you to invest back into your business.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

To sell Notion templates effectively, you need a seamless infrastructure that automates payment processing and product delivery. By utilizing tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script alongside NOWPayments, you can create a fully functional digital storefront. This architecture ensures that once a customer makes a payment, they receive their product instantly, all while you maintain complete ownership of your data and assets, eliminating reliance on external platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This framework is specifically designed for digital creators in regions like Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, and Venezuela, where access to traditional payment processors is severely limited. By adopting this system, creators can sell digital products such as templates and courses directly to their audience without the fear of payment rejection. It’s about empowering creators with the autonomy to operate independently while ensuring they can monetize their skills effectively.
Maintain full ownership of your digital products and data.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this infrastructure include a hosting platform like GitHub Pages for product display, backend logic via Cloudflare Workers for order processing, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. Each component works in harmony to provide a seamless experience, from product listing to payment confirmation. Additionally, using services like Supabase for order storage ensures that you have secure, reliable access to your transaction data, allowing for better tracking and customer management.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your Notion templates, start by selecting the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH. Set up your hosting environment on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and configure your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers. Integrate NOWPayments to facilitate crypto transactions, and upload your templates. Once deployed, you’ll have a fully operational store ready to accept payments without any platform dependencies. This architecture allows you to scale as needed, with lifetime access to your setup.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using decentralized payment solutions like NOWPayments. This service allows for processing payments in cryptocurrency, providing a straightforward way to accept funds without traditional banking constraints. This way, you keep more of your earnings while ensuring that your customers can easily purchase your products.
Save significantly on fees compared to traditional platforms.

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
